annotations.text:
E · Inner Child
Playful, sunlit, handwritten notes. "You were beautiful before anyone told you to be." Joy and permission to play.
Tradeoff: least formal — may feel young for premium bridal.

F · Her Voice
Feminist manifesto. Plum + coral, bold Bodoni. "Beauty is not a standard. It's a voice." Most charismatic and opinionated.
Tradeoff: strong stance — polarising to some clients.

G · Soft Power
Quiet confidence. Sand + terracotta, light serif, lots of air. "Charisma isn't loud."
Tradeoff: subtle — relies on excellent photography.

H · Bloom
Growth metaphor. Sage + lilac, organic shapes. "You were always the flower. We just water." Warm, nurturing, approachable.
Tradeoff: florals are a common salon motif.

I · Mirror
Cinematic self-recognition. Burgundy, candlelight, Italiana. "Meet the woman in the mirror." Strongest emotional pull for bridal.
Tradeoff: dark & dramatic — less everyday-friendly.
Earlier set (A–D) — kept for reference. The brief moved away from this commercial tone.
